scenes.title: The core carries changing magnetic flux
The turns ratio sets the voltage

vo.text: A transformer changes AC voltage for the power grid and your home.
vo.speak: A transformer changes AC voltage for the power grid and your home.

vo.text: It transfers electrical energy between two coils without a direct wire connection.
vo.speak: It transfers electrical energy between two coils without a direct wire connection.

vo.text: Alternating current enters the primary coil, so its magnetic field continually changes.
vo.speak: Alternating current enters the primary coil, so its magnetic field continually changes.

vo.text: The iron core guides this changing magnetic field around a closed loop.
vo.speak: The iron core guides this changing magnetic field around a closed loop.

vo.text: The field then passes through the secondary coil on the other side.
vo.speak: The field then passes through the secondary coil on the other side.

vo.text: Because the field keeps changing, it induces an alternating voltage in this second coil.
vo.speak: Because the field keeps changing, it induces an alternating voltage in this second coil.

vo.text: The number of wire turns controls the result.
vo.speak: The number of wire turns controls the result.

vo.text: More secondary turns increase voltage; fewer secondary turns decrease it.
vo.speak: More secondary turns increase voltage; fewer secondary turns decrease it.

vo.text: So the transformer uses magnetic induction to change voltage while transferring power between its coils.
vo.speak: So the transformer uses magnetic induction to change voltage while transferring power between its coils.
